star_state: USER_REPORTED; not verified through authenticated starred endpoint

sources.title: Anti UI Slop / Uizze
sources.license: MIXED: root MIT; anti-ui-slop Apache-2.0; service/assets separately licensed
sources.extract: Design contract, product-specific references, required UI states and finish gate; image-to-UI and UI Radar as separate optional workflows
sources.caveat: Primarily web/iOS instructions, not a native Flutter package. Hosted MCP is paid and reference images are not automatically redistributable.

sources.title: Impeccable
sources.license: Apache-2.0 (root); per-file/engine assets still require checking
sources.extract: Structured critique/audit, layout, typography, visual polish, accessibility, responsive and resilient UI states; deterministic anti-slop detector
sources.caveat: UX rules transfer conceptually to native apps; its own engine and browser instrumentation do not run as Flutter widgets.

sources.title: Taste Skill
sources.license: MIT (root); photo/icon asset-level licenses and credits must be checked
sources.extract: Web art direction, palette/font selection, hero layouts, copy checks and real-browser consistency/performance gate at multiple viewport widths
sources.caveat: Web-first HTML/CSS/React/Vue/Svelte/Astro workflow; not suitable as a runtime Flutter donor. Preserve existing approved app brand.

sources.title: Emil Design Engineering
sources.extract: Interaction motion, gesture physics, meaningful easing/duration, animation performance and break-ui stress checks; includes native-adjacent guidance
sources.caveat: Examples skew web/React/Expo; implement with Flutter Animation/Compose native primitives and respect reduced-motion/performance.

sources.title: Vercel Web Design Guidelines
sources.license: NOASSERTION at repository root; inspect each file and upstream live guidelines
sources.extract: Web accessibility, keyboard/focus, form validation, responsive typography, image performance, URL-driven state and localization; skills fetch external guideline version
sources.caveat: Rule source is fetched live from vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines, not pinned by this skill; do not treat web DOM rules as Android APIs.

sources.title: Anthropic Frontend Design
sources.license: Apache-2.0 for skills/frontend-design (per-skill); other skill assets separate
sources.extract: Distinctive subject-grounded visual direction, typography, palette, layout narrative and self-critique; avoid templated frontend patterns
sources.caveat: Creative frontend design guidance, not a finished mobile component; native UI must preserve Product Bible and platform behavior.

sources.title: Hallmark
sources.license: MIT root and skills/hallmark/LICENSE; photo/theme assets require per-file checks
sources.extract: 50 web themes, functional marketing page composition, redesign and render audit, real photographed assets with credits, custom page direction
sources.caveat: Do not replace in-app native layouts with its website themes or reuse third-party brand/photos without license review.

sources.title: Better Interfaces (Jakub Krehel)
sources.extract: Evidence-based design review across accessibility, copy, spacing, typography, color, interactive states; separate change-scoped interface review and stress scenarios
sources.caveat: Web-specific ARIA/focus rules are references only for native mobile semantics; do not claim a review without exact source and rendered evidence.

sources.title: UI UX Pro Max
sources.license: MIT (root); premium assets/features excluded; font/icon assets separately
sources.extract: Searchable local palettes, font pairings, style taxonomy, UX rules, design system token output; explicit Flutter and Jetpack Compose stack guidance
sources.caveat: Generated suggestions are options, not certified standards. Compare to existing design tokens/approved identity; benchmark Flutter impact before use.

sources.title: Stageshow
sources.license: MIT for stageshow/ (not blanket repo); bundled third-party brand assets carry separate notices
sources.extract: Believable product UI stills, bento feature cards, framed screenshots, animated cursor walkthroughs and recorded product demos
sources.caveat: Marketing mockups do not prove app features or runtime QA. Avoid fabricated product claims and unlicensed third-party marks.
